messages:
ana_release: Quick heads-up: late-window micro deploy in 15m. Plan: quiesce writes 20s, warm caches, pin runtime+router to v2.4.3-canary at 4% for 7m then 12% if steady. Rollback pin v2.4.2-stable. Any blockers?

chris_runtime: Suggest router.eviction-protect=true during drain. Also keep batching disabled for 5m post-deploy.

maya_console: I'll mute noisy dashboards and add a small UI banner: "Canary running". Posting changelog to #product-release.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight OK. Images ready. Use `/deploy start 8422000000` to begin.

sam_sre: Watching infra. Thresholds: p50>300ms or error_rate>1% sustained 90s -> cut. Will call rollback.

lee_api: No breaking API changes. Header-split ok after 12% stage.

ana_release: typo: ack -> ana_release. Starting quiesce in 2m.

chris_runtime: Quiesce started. Commands: `kubectl -n runtime rollout pause deploy/ingest` and `kubectl label pods -l app=router canary-protect=true --overwrite`.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary routing 4% to runtime/router v2.4.3-canary. Health hooks attached. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/8422000000

sam_sre: +3m: metrics green. Small CPU uptick on canary nodes but within limits.

maya_console: Banner posted and alerts muted.

ana_release: Holding for 7m then ramp to 12% if steady. Rollback plan on standby.
